description: Contains the nameplate information attached to the product.

items.description: Describes a Property which contains plain text in multiple languages. This is intended exclusively for human readable strings, not for identifiers, measurement values, etc.

Text.description: Describes a Property which contains plain text. This is intended exclusively for human readable strings, not for identifiers, measurement values, etc.

AdressInformation.description: Contains information on how to contact the manufacturer or an authorised service provider, e.g. when a maintenance service is required.

StreetName.description: Street name of the building where an organization is located (IEC 61360-7).

StreetNo.description:
Identification number of an entrance to a building related to a domain defined by the street as issued by the local authorities.

    synonym: house number

PostalCode.description: ZIP/postal code of the area in which an organization is located.

CityName.description: City or town where the company or organization is located.

CountryCode.description:
Two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code)

	NOTE: a value list with all country codes is available in IEC CDD, IRDI 0112/2///61360_7#CEA008#001

MimeType.description: A MIME type as defined in RFC 2046, for example "application/pdf".

FileWithContentType.description: A file is a data element that represents an address to a file (a locator). The value is a URI that can represent an absolute or relative path.

value.description:
Path and name of the file (with file extension).

The path can be absolute or relative.

contentType.description: Content type of the content of the file or blob.

TypeOfConformityRegulation.description:
Classification of a certificate or approval document according to the regulations against which the conformity of an entity is tested (IEC 61360-7).
	
	synonym: MarkingName

IdentifierOfCertificate.description:
Alphanumeric character sequence identifying a certificate, approval, declaration or license (EC 61360-7).

    NOTE: to be entered without spaces 

    synonym: DesignationOfCertificateOrApproval

CertificateSupplement.description: Running number or designation of a supplement/amendment issued to an existing certificate, approval, declaration or license.

DateOfIssue.description:
Date when a document was issued. 
	
	NOTE 1: The format for date is the lexical representation allowed by ISO 8601, i. e. "YYYY-MM-DD" with optional time zone.
	
	NOTE 2: The date of issue is normally the date, when the document becomes valid.

	synonym: IssueDate

EndOfValidity.description:
Date when a document becomes invalid.
	
	NOTE: The format for date is the lexical representation allowed by ISO 8601, i. e. "YYYY-MM-DD" with optional time zone.
	
	synonym: ExpiryDate

MarkingFile.description: Graphical symbol defined by and indicating conformance to a particular directive, standard or specification.

AdditionalMarkingText.description:
Additional plain text on a name plate indicating conformance to a particular directive, standard or specification.

	synonym: MarkingAdditionalText

Markings.description: Note: CE marking is declared as mandatory according to EU Blue Guide.

UniqueProductIdentifier.description:
Unique string of characters for the identification of a
	product, that also enables a web link to the digital product passport.

ProductBatchOrLotId.description: Unique global identification of a product batch or lot using an uniform resource identifier (URI).

ProductTypeId.description: Unique global identification of a product type using an uniform resource identifier (URI).

ManufacturerName.description: Designation of the entity, company or organization responsible for the manufacturing of the product.

ManufacturerId.description:
Fully qualified domain name of the manufacturer of a product using a uniform resource identifier (URI).
	
	NOTE: The URI comprises the URL and the URN

AddressInformation.description:
Properties providing the manufacturer contact information.
   
	NOTE: The manufacturer contact information of the typeplate, if defined by regulations.

TypeNameOfProduct.description:
First level of a product description hierarchy as defined by
	the manufacturer, characterizing the article or product
	based on its usage, operation principle and its fabricated form.
	
	synonym: ManufacturerProductRoot

FamilyNameOfProduct.description:
Second level of a product description hierarchy as defined
	by the manufacturer, classifying the article or product
	based on a manufacturer-specific nomenclature.

ModelNameOfProduct.description:
Third level of a product description hierarchy as defined by
	the manufacturer, being the article or product designation
	under which the article or product is marketed.
	
	NOTE: If there are more or fewer levels in the product
	description hierarchy, this property is used for the lowest
	level.
	
	synonym: ManufacturerProductDesignation

CodeOfProduct.description:
Combination of numbers and letters used to identify the
	type of product (product type).
	
	NOTE: CodeOfProduct may complement the property ModelNameOfProduct
	
	Example: Descriptive type code containing the exact specifications of the product

OrderCodeOfProduct.description:
Unique combination of numbers and letters used to
	configure and order the product instance.
	
	synonym: OrderCodeOfManufacturer, config ID

ArticleNumber.description:
Alphanumeric character sequence identifying a manufactured, non-configurable product.

	synonym: ProductArticleNumberOfManufacturer

SerialNumber.description: Unique combination of numbers and letters used to identify the instance of a device or entity once it has been manufactured.

DateOfManufacture.description:
Date when an item was manufactured.
	
	NOTE: The format for date is the lexical representation according to ISO 8601, i.e. "YYYY-MM-DD" with optional time zone

HardwareVersion.description: Current version of the hardware of the product.

FirmwareVersion.description: Current version of the firmware of the product.

SoftwareVersion.description: Current version of the software used by the product.

FacilityId.description:
Unique string of characters for the identification of locations or buildings involved in a product's value chain or used by actors  involved in a product's life cycle.

	NOTE: Typically, this should be the same identifier as used in the DPP metadata submodel template.

CompanyLogo.description:
Graphical symbol used to represent a manufacturer, a company, an organisation or a product 
	
	NOTE: The use of common image file formats (e.g. JPG, PNG) is recommended.

Markings.description:
Collection of several markings relevant to the product 
   
   NOTE: CE marking is declared as mandatory according to EU Blue Guide
